'''De'Hesta Bretu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper]] and a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Hidden Chain]]. He was involved in the attack on the [[Subterranean Power Station]] of [[Kessan's Landing]] during the [[Third Galactic War]], where he was killed. He wielded two [[Czerka Arms]] [[CZX-4 blaster pistol]]s.<ref name="TOR:COC"/>
